data.one_liner: A code generator for type-safe route helpers and definitions with package:go_router.
data.what_it_does: Generates strongly-typed route classes and navigation helpers for package:go_router. It uses code generation to translate route annotations and classes into type-safe go and push extension methods, replacing string-based path parameters with strongly-typed arguments.
use_when: You are using go_router and want compile-time type safety for route parameters.
You want to avoid writing manual string-based path and query parameter parsing logic.
avoid_when: You are not using package:go_router for navigation.
You prefer runtime configuration without build_runner code generation steps.
strengths: Compile-time type checking for route arguments and parameters
Reduces navigation boilerplate like manual int.parse or parameter extraction
weaknesses: Requires running build_runner for code generation
data.setup_notes: Requires adding build_runner and go_router_builder to dev_dependencies and running dart run build_runner build.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative routing solution that provides its own complete router and code generator without requiring go_router.
